resourceText: The periodic table arranges elements in order of increasing atomic number. Elements in the same group have similar chemical properties because they have the same number of outer-shell electrons. Group 1 metals are highly reactive, and reactivity increases down the group as the outer electron is lost more easily. Group 7 halogens are also highly reactive, but reactivity decreases down the group. Noble gases in Group 0 are unreactive because their outer shells are full.
